evals.prompt: Review PR #123 in owner/repo that adds a new skill under skills/, score it against the skill governance framework, and prepare a professional PR comment.
evals.expected_output: The skill fetches PR metadata with gh CLI, evaluates the changed skill, generates a weighted score report, and writes a polished Markdown PR review.

evals.prompt: Assess a PR that updates two skills in the marketplace repository and submit the governance review back to the PR.
evals.expected_output: The skill identifies both skill folders, evaluates each one, computes weighted scores, produces a multi-skill comment, and can post it back to GitHub.
